content:
marta_csm: Heads up — Hearthline just added two new product teams (Search + Recommendations) and started a soft rollout. We're seeing a sudden uptick in both chat and embedding traffic. 

alex_cs: Can you paste the numbers? :eyes:

marta_csm: From customer dashboard: 7-day avg qps 120 -> 420 today, token volume 70k/day -> ~370k/day. Embedding jobs 3/min -> 18/min. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/customers/hearthline/usage 

sam_eng: Oof. That'll push them into burst territory. Any errors or latency alerts?

marta_csm: No errors yet, but 95p latency jumped from 180ms -> 620ms on some routes. They're worried about UX for realtime features.

devon_se: Suggest we offer a Dedicated pilot or enable smart routing to higher-capacity models temporarily. I can prep a short runbook for them.

alex_cs: +1 on runbook. Also flagging renewal: their enterprise contract renews in 6 weeks. This expansion could be an upsell — or a risk if perf degrades. 

marta_csm: Exactly — I need a playbook and a compact price sketch for an interim burst buffer and Dedicated pilot. Can eng estimate cost delta? @sam_eng

sam_eng: Quick sketch: if we enable a small dedicated pool (2xA10s equivalent) and route embeds to batched workers, expected cost delta ~+$6k/mo but reduces p95 to <200ms for their workload. I can validate with a canary.

billing-bot: Billing alert: projected monthly usage for Hearthline increased from $9.2k to $34.7k based on current 7-day trend. Notify CSMs if you need quota changes.

hearthline-pm: (joined) thanks for the proactive heads up. We started the multi-team rollout last night. Can we prioritize a quick enablement call this week? Prefer Thu morning PST.

devon_se: I can run a 30-min enablement: ops patterns, batching, and cache hints. I'll also share a config snippet for routing and autoscale: 

```
route_policy: prefer_low_latency
dedicated_pool: small-burst
batching: {
  max_tokens: 4096,
  max_batch_latency_ms: 25
}
cache: {
  prefix_kv: enabled
}
```

alex_cs: Next steps: 1) sam run canary by EOD to validate p95 improvements, 2) devon schedule Thu AM enablement with Hearthline, 3) I prepare a renewal note + pricing delta. Marta — want me on the call?

marta_csm: Yes please. I'll schedule and post the invite. Also I'll capture feedback during enablement for the renewal playbook. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: Starting canary now, will post results in this thread within 2-3 hours. :rocket:

marta_csm: Thanks team — keeping this one on my renewal radar. If latency holds, high chance of expansion and a smooth renewal. If not, escalate to SE and SRE.

alex_cs: Good. Add a quick note to the account health doc (internal): https://confluence.redwood.com/CS/Accounts/Hearthline — mark as "expansion-signal" and set renewal_risk: monitor.

hearthline-pm: Appreciate it. We'll freeze any further rollouts until after the enablement.

sam_eng: Canary done — p95 down to 190ms, embeddings throughput steady. Posting logs & metrics snapshot in a follow-up. :white_check_mark:
